summary: A 1930 early model L-4 with expanded catwalks, built by the BIA on the San Carlos Reservation and listed as standing; no staffing or access record was found.

facts.design: early model L-4 with expanded catwalks

events.note: Constructed by the BIA on the San Carlos Reservation

evidence.supports: built 1930 by the BIA on the San Carlos Reservation; early model L-4 with expanded catwalks; part of the San Carlos Agency fire management system
evidence.quote: The Hilltop Lookout on the San Carlos Reservation is an early model L-4 with expanded catwalks constructed by the BIA in 1930. It is part of the San Carlos Agency fire management system.

evidence.supports: Gila County, Arizona; San Carlos Apache Reservation
Gila County; FFLA type Ground, status Standing; NHLR US 632
evidence.quote: Hilltop Gila 33.57497 -110.37864 Ground Standing NHLR US 632, AZ 56

corrections.why: The NHLR entry describes the lookout only as an early model L-4 with catwalks and gives no construction material. The record's material came from a design field that is null.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources were readable: the NHLR entry and the FFLA Arizona list. A HikeArizona trip report for this lookout (photoset ID 63934) may cover access, but the site returned HTTP 403, so it is not cited. A Surgent highpoints page failed on an expired TLS certificate and was not read. Staffing and public access are unknown and the story says so. The record lists ownership as unknown; the reservation setting suggests tribal, but no source I read says so. No new photos found beyond the NHLR photo already in the record.
